change.hypothesis: A single bounded follow-up: target scaling severely overfits two training days; test whether ten training days mitigate that failure at identical 1500 updates. This is not a repetition on the same data or a claim that scaling is already accepted.

decision: Complete the third seed, summarize all six paired cases and daily blocks. Retain train_std as a research configuration only if gains remain positive in each research period and guard metrics do not show material deterioration; no claim of independent final validation.
